records.title: 删除主档后备份删除失败的已提交前缀未被明确规定
premises: 固定默认保存路径和.bak均存在；用户已通过必要删除确认；无并发、无覆写；主档删除正常成功，备份删除报SystemCallError且没有删除备份；失败提示本身正常。
records.ordinary_control: 同输入但两次删除均成功：两文件消失，UI请求成功提示。首次删除即失败且未删主档：两文件保留，后面的备份删除未到。

steps: 确认删除，调用顺序先主档、后.bak
给定主档删除成功；.bak删除被权限拒绝
minimal_counterexample.source_expected: UI捕获错误并请求删除失败提示；主档已不存在，.bak仍存在；没有恢复主档步骤。
minimal_counterexample.spec_difference: 当前内核只写删除两文件和失败被捕获/提示，未明确该可得的部分删除状态；需UI全篇主合同反证排除重复。

normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.cancel: 确认前取消不调用删除，原文件保持；具体多重确认归UI主合同。
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.failure: 第二次删除失败只中断当前删除入口，外层捕获后继续后继UI。
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.partial_commit: 已删除主档没有自动撤回；不能从失败提示推出两文件均保留。
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.following_state: 无效档删除提示入口即使delete_save_data捕获失败仍重建两个系统对象；显式删除画面则正常结束后回标题。

negative_evidence.searched: generic-kernel全部11及两catalog完整阅读；rg定位wp65相关删除条款，wp65整篇尚待独立owner接收。
negative_evidence.found: WP07目录树部分删除不是SaveData的主档/备份二文件入口，不能代替此合同。
negative_evidence.missing: UI主责可能已有完整前缀，存在则撤销本提案或仅引用同步。

records.impact: 独立实现可能误把“删除失败”当作两文件仍在，或者只依据反馈决定恢复/再次删除，丢失准确状态合同。
records.minimal_revision_contract: 以有界操作结果说明主档先删、备份后删；第二步失败不恢复主档；捕获/提示与真实文件状态分开；不要求未来复制该非原子行为。
correct_scope_to_preserve: 删除确认/取消、错误捕获范围、默认路径与仅删除一层.bak、地图/转换/普通保存边界均保持。
acceptance_and_regression: 两步成功、首步失败、第二步失败三对照分别具名；列原文件/备份存在性和UI后续；NOT_EXECUTED保留。
recommended_sync_write_set: UI主责核定后必要同步wp65及其test-catalog

blocking: UI主合同完整接收与非提案者反证
nonblocking: 宿主I/O实际运行，不阻塞有界静态前缀

premises: Default source, no Console.markup_style override/alias; matching legacy content; successful ordinary I/O.
records.ordinary_control: Match rewrites full file; no match performs no write; neither requests output from discarded formatter result.

steps: Trainer_types includes VictoryME or moves includes BaseDamage.
Run updater with successful file operations.
minimal_counterexample.source_expected: Content becomes VictoryBGM/Power; markup_style only returns constructed formatted string, unused by caller; no echo/print request.
minimal_counterexample.spec_difference: WP04:196 affirmatively claims Changes made to file X prompt.

normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.failure: I/O errors may propagate; formatting is not diagnostic I/O.
normal_cancel_failure_partial_commit.partial_commit: Whole-file wb can truncate/partially write if it fails; proposal changes only output assertion.

negative_evidence.scope: Full Compiler001 and DebugConsole read; global source rg def/alias markup_style and Changes made string.
negative_evidence.result: Single pure-string formatter definition; caller discards result; no default override/alias or other output consumer found.
negative_evidence.boundary: Plugin override excluded by stated default premise.

records.impact: An independent implementation can add observable output absent from default reference.
records.minimal_revision_contract: Remove actual-prompt assertion or say formatted string constructed without default output request.

acceptance_and_regression: Changed and unchanged file; content effects separate from output requests; verify formatter return unused; NOT_EXECUTED.
